proposal.summary: Multiple command injection vulnerabilities could lead to unauthenticated remote code execution via specially crafted packets to the PAPI UDP port (8211).

AV.quote: by sending specially crafted packets destined to the PAPI (Aruba Networks access point management protocol) UDP port (8211)

C.quote: result in the ability to execute arbitrary code as a privileged user on the underlying operating system
